purpose: Determine whether Actions would build the intended RB-C2 package or stale remote code. No cutover. No push. No PASS claim.
actionsBuildModel: actions/checkout@v4 of default branch main, then docker build of repo source (excludes _publish). Local _publish is comparison baseline only.
verdict: Intended package exists only in the local working tree. origin/main tip equals local HEAD but does NOT contain working-tree package-identity changes. Dispatching now would build STALE remote code without packageIdentity/runtime-truth.
